productMaster.title: Product master
productMaster.subtitle: Every item both companies make, buy or sell, in one list: group › family › product › pack. Admin adds groups and products; each Tally name stays as an alias.

productMaster.noRight: You can read the product list. Adding or changing products, groups and GST rates is an Admin right — ask Admin.

mrp.title: MRP · {{name}}
mrp.help: A new MRP takes effect from its date. Earlier MRPs stay in the history and are never edited. A tax-inclusive price can never go above MRP.
mrp.err: Enter the MRP in rupees, e.g. 120.00.

g.title: Product groups
g.help: Each product sits in one group, so reports add up by group without counting anything twice. A group can belong to one company or be shared.

g.formHelp: Only Admin changes the tree. Every change is in the user log.
g.emptyBodyAdmin: Add the first group, then place products in it.

h.title: HSN and GST rates
h.help: GST rates come only from this table, each from a date. The ERP never assumes a rate: Admin enters each version and the CA confirms it before the first bill.
h.addHelp: The 4 to 8 digit code and its description. Add the GST rate afterwards, from a date.
h.noHistory: No rate entered for this HSN yet.
h.rateHelp: The new rate applies from its date; the earlier version closes the day before. Nothing is edited in place.
h.rateNoPrefill: Type the rate from the notification. Nothing is filled in for you.
h.caCheckbox: This rate is confirmed by the CA
h.caHint: Leave unticked until the CA has checked it. Products show "Not confirmed" until then.
h.emptyBodyAdmin: Add the HSN codes your products use, then their GST rates.
h.emptyBody: Admin adds HSN codes and their GST rates; the CA confirms them.
h.errFrom: Choose the date the rate applies from.

u.title: Units
u.help: GST unit codes (UQC) used for stock and on bills. Litres and kilograms are never swapped without an approved density.
u.label: Unit

holds.title: What every product record holds
holds.b1: Product code, group, family, product name, variant (scent, colour, size), Tally aliases, barcode (GTIN) kept as text.
holds.b2: Net quantity and its unit, pack size and stock unit. Litres and kilograms are never swapped without an approved density.
holds.b3: HSN and the GST rate from its date, cosmetics licence number for soaps and washes, MRP including all taxes.
holds.b4: MRP, shop rate, distributor and online price lists. A bill never goes above MRP.
holds.b5: Make or buy, approved formula and revision, packing list, shelf life and QC tests arrive with manufacturing.
holds.b6: Maker's name and address, net quantity, MRP, batch, manufacture and expiry dates, licence number and consumer care.

rules.title: Grouping rules
rules.b1: Each item sits in exactly one group, so reports add up by group without double counting.
rules.t2: Pack, scent and colour are separate products
rules.b2: Two sizes or two fragrances of the same item each get their own code, so stock and sales add up.
rules.b3: The import matches Tally names to products, so history and stock carry over. Names the rules can't place wait in "To be grouped" for Admin.
rules.b4: Adding a group or product is an Admin right. Every change is in the user log.
rules.b5: Each company keeps its own code scheme; the code is fixed once the product is saved.
